response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Yes... When I heard the music coming from up in the clouds, I was so stunned, I could barely think or move.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I felt like it had a special kind of hold over me... Hmm, or maybe it was the adeptal power within the music?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: And the ensemble at the end was truly sublime! I felt like I would have started to cry if I hadn't been one of the performers on the stage.

choices.text: What are your plans for the future?

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Well, Lady Ningguang, the Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing, has invited me to visit her again at Yujing Terrace to discuss a long-term collaboration plan.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: I do hope everything goes well, and that we have more opportunities to collaborate in the future.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: The next time we have another performance, you'll have to come! I will save the best seat for you.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: Haha... I have already given her my thanks in person.

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: This is what she said: "It is only natural to lend a hand when we see someone in distress. The wonderful music you brought to Liyue is worth far more than gratitude."

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: But I've also made a decision for myself: I will strive to create even more wonderful, original music for this era... our era!

response.speaker: Dvorak
response.text: #We couldn't have accomplished all of this without you, {NICKNAME}. Please accept my most heartfelt thanks again!
